The **Pooling** group of the node palette has 5 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Adaptive Average Pool](../pooling/adaptive-average-pool.md) | Runs | Average-pools any [H,W,C] feature map to output_size x output_size. |
| [AvgPool2D](../pooling/avgpool2d.md) | Runs | Averages each pooling window. |
| [Global Avg Pool](../pooling/global-avg-pool.md) | Runs | Averages each channel over H and W: [H,W,C] -> [C]. |
| [Global Max Pool](../pooling/global-max-pool.md) | Runs | Takes each channel's maximum over H and W ([H,W,C] -> [C]) or over L ([L,C] -> [C]) |
| [MaxPool2D](../pooling/maxpool2d.md) | Runs | Keeps the largest value of each pooling window. |
